# API reference (generated by scripts/gen_api_doc.py - do not edit by hand)

## Blender modules (`import avz_*` after the SKILL.md bootstrap)

### `avz_assets` — avz_assets - bring downloaded assets (.blend from Poly Haven / BlenderKit / own library) into the scene as

- `append_blend(path, name=None, library='AVZ_Library', types=KEEP_TYPES, max_dim=None)` — Append all objects of `path` into a hidden collection (excluded from the view layer) for instancing. instance_offset = bottom-centre of the asset, so instances stand exactly on their location. Returns the collection; coll['avz_dims'] = real size in metres (CHECK IT - some assets are mis-scaled).
- `instance(coll, location, rot_z_deg=0.0, scale=1.0, name=None, target='Entourage')`
- `ground_z(x, y, snap_to=None, z_from=2000.0, default=None)` — Height of the first surface below (x, y). snap_to: list of objects to accept (others are skipped).
- `scatter_line(assets, p0, p1, spacing, jitter=0.3, scale=(0.9, 1.15), seed=0, snap_to=None, target='Entourage', prefix='line', start_offset=None)` — Trees along a street etc. p0/p1 world (x, y). Returns the instances.
- `scatter_area(assets, polygon_xy, density=None, count=None, min_dist=1.0, scale=(0.8, 1.2), seed=0, snap_to=None, target='Entourage', prefix='area', max_tries=20000)` — Dart-throwing (Poisson-like) scatter inside a world-space polygon. density = items per m2.
- `gn_scatter(target, coll, density=100.0, scale=(0.7, 1.3), seed=0, name=None, selection_attr=None, keep_surface=True, viewport=True)` — Geometry-Nodes instancing of `coll` (each child = one variant) on the faces of `target`. density = instances per m2 (grass tufts 200-800, ground cover 5-50). selection_attr = float/bool attribute or vertex-group name that masks where to scatter.

### `avz_common` — avz_common - shared helpers for the blender-archviz skill.  Runs INSIDE Blender (needs bpy).

- `reload_all()` — (Re)import all avz_* modules in dependency order (call after editing any script).
- `set_project(path)` — Store the project root in the scene (persists in the .blend).
- `project_dir()`
- `subdir(*parts)`
- `tool_path(name)` — Absolute path of a CLI tool shipped with the skill (e.g. 'polyhaven_fetch.py').
- `clean_env()` — Environment for subprocesses launched FROM Blender: drop Blender's PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME etc., otherwise uv's interpreter imports Blender's (wrong-ABI) numpy and crashes.
- `find_uv()`
- `run_tool(name, *args, timeout=3600)` — Run one of the skill's uv scripts from inside Blender. Returns CompletedProcess.
- `collection(name, parent=None, exclude=False, hide_render=False)` — Get/create a collection linked under `parent` (default: scene root).
- `find_layer_collection(name, lc=None)`
- `clear_collection(coll)`
- `mesh_object(name, verts, faces, coll, materials=(), replace=True, smooth=False)` — Create a mesh object from python lists/arrays (data API, fast, no operators).
- `world_vertices(ob)`
- `bbox_points(objs)` — 8 world-space bound-box corners per object -> (N,3) array (cheap proxy of the geometry).
- `bbox(objs)`
- `tag_model(objs)` — Mark imported building objects (FBX/OBJ/glTF/IFC...). Datasmith imports are tagged automatically.
- `model_objects(scene=None)` — The architect's model: objects tagged by an importer (ds_name / avz_model); fallback = every mesh that is not in the support collections created by the skill (Site, Context, Entourage, ...).
- `mesh_objects(scene=None, collections=None, visible_only=True)`
- `class Frame` — Building-aligned 2-D frame. u axis at `angle_deg` CCW from +X, origin at world (x0, y0).
  - `.to_world(u, v, z=0.0)`
  - `.xy(u, v)`
  - `.from_world(x, y)`
  - `.uvz(P)`
  - `.u_bearing()`
  - `.outward_bearing(side)`
  - `.as_dict()`
  - `.from_dict(d)`
  - `.store(key='avz_frame')`
  - `.load(key='avz_frame')`
- `detect_frame(objs=None, store=True)` — Dominant horizontal orientation from vertical faces (area-weighted circular mean of 4*theta). Returns (Frame, extents) where the frame origin is the (u_min, v_min) corner of the geometry and extents = dict(u=(0,len_u), v=(0,len_v), z=(zmin,zmax), strength=0..1). strength < 0.5 means the plan is not 
- `side_profile(frame, objs=None, step=2.0, band=0.6)` — Lowest geometry z along each footprint side (helps to infer street/terrain grades). Returns {side: [(u_or_v_center, zmin), ...]} for sides 'v-' (v=vmin), 'v+', 'u-', 'u+'. Filter `objs` (e.g. only doors/windows/plinth) to read sills and ground contact lines.

### `avz_materials` — avz_materials - photoreal shader builders for archviz (Cycles/EEVEE, Blender 4.2+/5.x).  Runs INSIDE Blender.

- `tex_roots()`
- `find_maps(folder)`
- `ensure_polyhaven(asset_id, res='2k')` — Download a Poly Haven texture set (CC0) into the project if missing. Returns its folder.
- `tex_set(tex, fetch=True)` — Resolve a texture set: absolute folder, or id searched in the project's texture roots (auto-fetch).
- `img(path, non_color=False)`
- `mean_lum(im)` — Mean linear luminance of an image (cached).
- `reset(mat)`
- `sock(node, name, kind=None, out=False)`
- `mix_rgb(nt, blend, fac, a, b)`
- `math_node(nt, op, a, b=None, clamp=False)`
- `coords(nt, mode='UV', scale=(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), rot_deg=0.0, uvmap=None, offset=(0, 0, 0))` — Texture vector. mode: 'UV' (metre UVs), 'OBJECT' (object space), 'GENERATED'.
- `tex_node(nt, vec, path, non_color=False, box=False)`
- `macro_variation(nt, color, amount=0.08, scale=0.35, seed=0.0)` — Low-frequency value variation (object space) that kills CG uniformity on large surfaces.
- `principled(nt)`
- `clamp_albedo(c, lo=0.02, hi=0.85)` — Physically plausible albedo: no pure white/black surfaces.
- `pbr(mat, tex, width_m=2.0, *, tint=None, tint_strength=1.0, rough=None, normal=1.0, height=0.0, rot_deg=0.0, mode='UV', uvmap=None, macro=0.06, sat=None, val=1.0, ao=0.0, bevel=0.0, spec=0.5, metallic=0.0, coat=0.0)` — Image PBR material with REAL-WORLD scale. tex : texture-set id (Poly Haven id, auto-downloaded) or folder. width_m : real width of one texture tile in metres (height follows the image pixel aspect). mode : 'UV' (UVs must be in metres - the importers guarantee this), 'OBJECT', 'BOX' (box projection i
- `solid(mat, color, rough=0.5, metal=0.0, coat=0.0, bevel=0.0, spec=0.5, noise_bump=0.0, macro=0.0, sheen=0.0, clamp=True)`
- `glass(mat, tint=(0.9, 0.95, 0.94), rough=0.0, ior=1.52, thin=False, reflect=1.0)` — Architectural glazing. Camera/glossy rays see refractive glass with reflections; shadow and diffuse rays pass through tinted-transparent so sun and skylight reach the interiors (no caustic noise). thin=True for single-plane glass (Principled 'Thin Wall' when available).
- `invisible(mat)` — For helper geometry exported by BIM tools (clearance zones, analytic volumes...).
- `water(mat, depth_color=(0.25, 0.75, 0.85), density=0.6, ripple=0.25)` — Pool / pond water: refractive surface, procedural ripples, volume absorption for depth colour.
- `mosaic(mat, size=0.025, c1=(0.36, 0.62, 0.72), c2=(0.3, 0.55, 0.66), grout=(0.75, 0.78, 0.78), rough=0.12)` — Procedural square mosaic / tiles in object space (pools, bathrooms).
- `slab_mix(mat, top_builder, side_color, bottom_color, side_rough=0.85, bottom_rough=0.9)` — Horizontal slabs/sidewalks: `top_builder(mat)` on up-facing faces, plain colours on edges/soffits. (World-space normal test, so it works for any slab object without separate material slots.)
- `image_material(mat, path, width_m=1.0, rough=0.45, tint=None, rot_deg=0.0, coat=0.0, mode='UV')` — Single colour image (e.g. a wood/fabric swatch shipped with the model) at real-world scale.
- `emission(mat, color=(1.0, 0.85, 0.65), strength=8.0)`
- `facade_procedural(name, wall=(0.78, 0.76, 0.71), bay=3.3, floor_h=3.0, win_w=1.25, win_h=1.45, sill=0.95, z0=0.6, shutter=(0.55, 0.52, 0.46), seed=0.0)` — Cheap background-building facade (windows + random roller shutters) in OBJECT space. Use on axis-aligned boxes whose local X/Y run along the facades (see avz_site.context_block).
- `slope_uvs(me, name='UVslope')` — Planar UVs per face in metres: U along the contour line, V up the slope (roof tiles, ramps).
- `uv_units_per_metre(objs, sample=200)` — Median UV length / world length over triangle edges (1.0 = metre UVs, 3.2808 = feet, ...).

### `avz_matrules` — avz_matrules - first-pass automatic PBR upgrade of imported (BIM/CAD) materials.  Runs INSIDE Blender.

- `tag_source_materials(objs=None, overwrite=False)` — Record the imported look of materials (label, base colour, texture, opacity) before rebuilding. Datasmith imports do this automatically; call it after FBX/OBJ/glTF/USD/IFC imports.
- `src_color(m)`
- `classify(label)`
- `apply(materials=None, overrides=None, dry_run=False, uv_mode='auto')` — Classify + rebuild materials. Default set: every material with a `src_label` (imported model). overrides: {label_or_name: category}; category 'skip' leaves a material untouched. uv_mode: 'auto' (UV if UVs are ~metres else BOX projection), 'UV', 'BOX', 'OBJECT'.

### `avz_scene` — avz_scene - cameras, quick previews, analysis renders and scene audit.  Runs INSIDE Blender.

- `get_camera(name, collection_name='Cameras')`
- `look_at(ob, target)`
- `level_camera(name, eye, target, lens=24.0, sensor=36.0, shift=(0.0, 0.0))` — Level (two-point perspective) camera at `eye` looking horizontally towards `target`.
- `orbit_camera(name, target, bearing_deg, elevation_deg, distance, lens=35.0)` — Aerial / bird's-eye camera: placed at compass `bearing_deg` FROM the target, looking at it.
- `fit_level_camera(cam, objs=None, points=None, margin=0.05, lens=None, lens_range=(14.0, 135.0), recenter=True, res=None)` — Solve yaw (centre horizontally), focal length and shift_y so `points` (default: bound-box corners of `objs`, default all visible meshes) fill the frame with `margin` (fraction per side). Keeps the camera level. Returns lens/shift and warnings (shift > 0.5 or lens < 16 look distorted).
- `frame_points(frame, u0, u1, v0, v1, z0, z1)` — Box corners in a building Frame - handy `points` for fit_level_camera.
- `cycles_preview(path, cam, res=(960, 540), samples=32, noise=0.05)` — Small Cycles render with the scene's look/world. Keep < ~1 min (MCP calls are synchronous).
- `workbench(path, cam, res=(1280, 720), shadows=False, cavity=True, color_type='MATERIAL')` — Fast solid-colour analysis render. shadows=False by default: Workbench stencil shadows produce huge fake 'light fans' with open/non-manifold BIM meshes (glazing, railings).
- `analysis_views(objs=None, out_dir=None, res=(1000, 700), prefix='an')` — Top orthographic + 4 axonometric workbench views around the model -> list of PNG paths.
- `audit()` — Quick health report of the scene (call after import and before final renders).

### `avz_site` — avz_site - ground, streets, sidewalks with curbs, road markings, background buildings, distant terrain.

- `axis(a0, a1, step, extra=())`
- `grid(frame, us, vs, zfun, mask=None)`
- `terrain(name, frame, u0, u1, v0, v1, zfun, mat, step=2.0, mask=None, extra_u=(), extra_v=(), coll='Site')` — Open surface (roads, lawns, terrain). `mask(u,v)` False -> no face (holes for buildings). Put footprint edges in extra_u/extra_v so holes have straight borders.
- `slab(name, frame, u0, u1, v0, v1, zfun, mat, step=0.5, drop=0.2, coll='Site')` — Rectangular paved slab whose top follows zfun, with vertical edge faces dropping `drop` metres (= the curb seen from the road). Use a slab_mix material: paving on top, concrete on the curb.
- `round_corner(name, frame, cu, cv, r, a0_deg, a1_deg, zfun, mat, seg=16, drop=0.2, coll='Site')` — Quarter (or any arc) sidewalk piece centred at (cu, cv) - for street corners.
- `polygon_slab(name, pts_xy, z, mat, drop=0.2, coll='Site')` — Flat slab from an arbitrary simple polygon in world XY (CCW), e.g. a plaza or terrace.
- `strip(frame, p0, p1, width, zfun, step=1.0, lift=0.004)` — Thin quad strip from p0=(u,v) to p1 following zfun -> (verts, faces) piece.
- `dashed(frame, p0, p1, zfun, width=0.12, dash=3.0, gap=4.0)`
- `zebra(frame, center, direction, road_width, zfun, bars=None, bar=0.5, gap=0.5, length=4.0)` — Pedestrian crossing centred at `center` (u,v); `direction`=(du,dv) unit vector ACROSS the road.
- `markings(name, pieces, mat=None, coll='Site')`
- `paint_material(name='AVZ_road_paint')`
- `site_materials(prefix='AVZ', rot_deg=0.0, asphalt='asphalt_02', paving='concrete_pavement', soil='dry_ground_rocks', grass='leafy_grass')` — Standard site materials (Poly Haven, auto-downloaded). rot_deg aligns paving joints with the Frame (pass frame.angle_deg). Object-space mapping -> no UVs needed on generated site meshes.
- `context_block(name, frame, u0, u1, v0, v1, height, mat, base_z=0.0, roof_mat=None, coll='Context')` — Box building aligned with the Frame; object space == facade space (for facade_procedural).
- `facade_set(n=5, seed=7, palette=None)`
- `block_row(prefix, frame, along, a0, a1, front, away, zfun, depth=(11, 16), width=(11, 22), heights=(6.4, 9.4, 9.4, 12.4), mats=None, roof_mat=None, seed=1, coll='Context')` — Row of background buildings along a street. along='u' -> blocks span u in [a0,a1], street-facing facade at v=front, extending towards `away` (+1/-1). along='v' -> same with axes swapped.
- `hills_ring(name='AVZ_hills', center=(0.0, 0.0), r_inner=350.0, r_outer=4000.0, high_bearing=None, max_h=380.0, base_h=40.0, spread_deg=55.0, z0=-5.0, seed=3, coll='Context')` — Low-poly terrain ring for the horizon (mountains towards `high_bearing`, gentle elsewhere). Casts no shadows. Set high_bearing=None for flat-ish surroundings.

### `avz_world` — avz_world - sky, sun, colour management and Cycles render presets.  Runs INSIDE Blender.

- `solar_position(lat, lon, year, month, day, hour, minute=0, utc_offset=0.0)` — NOAA solar position. Returns (elevation_deg, true_bearing_deg) for local clock time. utc_offset: hours east of UTC incl. DST (Spain summer = +2, winter = +1).
- `bearing_to_azimuth(bearing_deg)` — Compass bearing (from +Y, clockwise) -> math azimuth (from +X, CCW), radians.
- `hdri_sun(im)` — (azimuth_from_+X_rad, elevation_rad, peak) of the brightest pixel of an equirect image.
- `setup_hdri(path, sun_bearing=None, rotation_deg=None, strength=1.0, camera_strength=None, saturation=1.0, world_name='AVZ_Sky')` — HDRI world. sun_bearing: model-space compass bearing where the HDRI sun must end up (auto-rotates the map). The HDRI fixes the sun ELEVATION - choose an HDRI whose sun height matches the wanted time of day ('puresky' Poly Haven HDRIs have no ground, ideal when you model your own site). camera_streng
- `setup_sky(sun_elevation_deg, sun_bearing_deg, model='MULTIPLE_SCATTERING', strength=1.0, sun_lamp=False, lamp_strength=4.0, altitude=0.0, air=1.0, aerosol=1.0, ozone=1.0, world_name='AVZ_Sky')` — Physical procedural sky (any sun position/time of day). Blender 5.x models: SINGLE_SCATTERING, MULTIPLE_SCATTERING, PREETHAM, HOSEK_WILKIE. sun_rotation of the node == compass bearing. sun_lamp=True adds a matching Sun light (crisper shadows / EEVEE).
- `add_sun_lamp(elevation_deg, bearing_deg, strength=4.0, angle_deg=0.53, name='AVZ_Sun')`
- `configure_device(kind='CPU')` — kind: CPU | HIP | CUDA | OPTIX | METAL | ONEAPI. Sets user prefs + scene device. WARNING: test GPU backends with avz_bench.py in a *background* process first - a driver crash takes the interactive Blender (and the MCP session) down with it.
- `setup_render(samples=256, noise=0.02, res=(1920, 1080), pct=100, denoise=True, look='AgX - Medium High Contrast', exposure=0.0, clamp_indirect=8.0, device=None, film_transparent=False, motion_blur=False)` — Archviz Cycles preset: adaptive sampling + OIDN, light tree, clamped indirect, AgX view transform.

## Command-line tools

### `udsmesh_convert.py`

```
Convert Datasmith .udsmesh files into .npz mesh caches that Blender loads with numpy.

usage:  udsmesh_convert.py <assets_dir_with_udsmesh> <cache_dir> [--jobs N]

Supports both on-disk formats:
  * UE5 "FDatasmithPackedMeshes" (Datasmith SDK >= 5.x, e.g. Revit/ArchiCAD/SketchUp exporters 2023+):
    Oodle-Kraken compressed FMeshDescription (Vertices / VertexInstances / Triangles / PolygonGroups).
  * Legacy UE4 FRawMesh (header u32=1, "SourceModels" / "DatasmithMeshSourceModel" strings).

Output per mesh (Blender space: metres, right-handed Z-up -> x, -y, z):
  v  float32 (N,3)   positions          f  int32 (T,3) triangles      m int32 (T,) polygon-group index
  n  float32 (3T,3)  corner normals     uv0..uv3 float32 (3T,2) raw source UV units, V flipped (1-v)
  slots  str (G,)    material slot name of each polygon group (usually "0","1",.. = <Material id> in XML)
index.json: per-mesh stats + errors + global "uv_units_per_m" estimate (Revit exports feet: 3.2808).
Winding is verified against the stored normals and flipped per mesh when needed.
```

### `polyhaven_fetch.py`

```
Poly Haven (CC0 - free for commercial use, no attribution required) browser/downloader.

usage:
  polyhaven_fetch.py [--root PROJECT] list {hdris,textures,models} [--cat CATEGORY] [--filter a,b] [--limit 24]
        -> contact sheet JPG (read it to choose visually) + JSON list on stdout
  polyhaven_fetch.py [--root PROJECT] hdri  <id> [--res 4k] [--fmt exr]
  polyhaven_fetch.py [--root PROJECT] tex   <id> [--res 2k]     (diff, nor_gl, rough, disp, ao, arm)
  polyhaven_fetch.py [--root PROJECT] model <id> [--res 2k]     (.blend + its textures)
  polyhaven_fetch.py info <id>

Files go to PROJECT/assets/polyhaven/{hdri,tex/<id>,models/<id>}; sheets to PROJECT/previews/assets/.
Useful categories: hdris: skies (ids ending in _puresky = sky only, no ground), outdoor, sunrise-sunset,
urban; textures: plaster, concrete, brick, roofing, wood, floor, tiles, asphalt, cobblestone, terrain;
models: plants, trees, furniture, outdoor.
```

### `blenderkit_fetch.py`

```
BlenderKit / Blendkit FREE assets without the add-on or an account (public API).

usage:
  blenderkit_fetch.py [--root PROJECT] search "<query>" [--type model|material|hdr|scene] [--n 12] [--extra "..."]
        -> contact sheet JPG + JSON (id, name, faces, real dimensions, licence) on stdout
  blenderkit_fetch.py [--root PROJECT] get <assetBaseId> [--res resolution_2K|resolution_1K|blend]

Search terms are English; results are ranked by score; only is_free:true assets are returned.  Free assets are
'royalty_free' (commercial use OK, no redistribution of the asset itself) or 'cc_zero'.  Check `faces`
(1M+ face trees are heavy) and `dims_m` (real-world size) before using an asset.
Files go to PROJECT/assets/blenderkit/<name>_<id8>/; sheets to PROJECT/previews/assets/.
```

### `contact_sheet.py`

```
Combine renders/previews into one labelled overview image (one `read` to review many images).

usage: contact_sheet.py OUT.jpg IMG [IMG ...] [--cols 3] [--width 640]
```

### `avz_render.py`

```
Batch final renders in a BACKGROUND Blender (no MCP timeouts, GUI session stays safe).

usage:
  blender -b PROJECT.blend -P avz_render.py -- [--cams CAM_A,CAM_B | --cams all] [--res 3840x2160] [--pct 100]
          [--samples 512] [--noise 0.01] [--device CPU|HIP|HIPRT|CUDA|OPTIX|METAL|ONEAPI] [--out DIR]
          [--prefix NAME_] [--exr] [--jpg] [--look "AgX - Medium High Contrast"] [--exposure 0.0]
          [--time-limit SECONDS]

Defaults: all cameras of collection "Cameras" (names starting with "_" or "AVZ_" are skipped),
resolution/samples from the .blend, output PROJECT/renders/.  Per-camera overrides via custom properties on
the camera object: avz_res = "2160x3840", avz_samples = 1024, avz_exposure = 0.3.
Writes PNG 16-bit (+ optional multilayer EXR / JPG 92) and appends a JSON line per image to
renders/render_log.jsonl.  Run it with `nohup ... &` for long batches and poll the log.
```

### `avz_bench.py`

```
Render-device benchmark / crash test in a BACKGROUND Blender (never test a new GPU backend in the GUI).

usage:
  blender -b PROJECT.blend -P avz_bench.py -- --device CPU|HIP|HIPRT|CUDA|OPTIX|METAL|ONEAPI
          [--samples 64] [--res 960x540] [--cam NAME] [--out /tmp/bench.png]

Prints "BENCH {...json...}" on success.  Exit code 134/139 or 'HSA_STATUS_ERROR' / 'illegal' in the log
means the GPU backend crashes on this machine -> use CPU (check `journalctl -k | grep amdgpu` on Linux).
Nothing is saved to the .blend.
```

### `gen_api_doc.py`

```
Regenerate reference/api.md from the scripts' signatures and docstrings (run after extending the library).

usage: gen_api_doc.py            (writes <skill>/reference/api.md)
```
